citations.quote: George Calvelo, ABS-CBN News MANILA — Malacañang advised the Department of the Interior and Local Government on Wednesday to keep its legal operations under wraps after Secretary Jonvic Remulla claimed that former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque's asylum application in Austria had been denied.

“At kung mayroong ibang mga legal na operasyon na gagawin ang DILG, definitely mayroon tayong kasabihan na ‘do not telegraph your punches.’ So, hayaan na lang po nating si Secretary Jonvic ang sumagot patungkol diyan,” Castro continued.
(And if the DILG has other legal operations that it plans to undertake, we definitely have a saying: “Do not telegraph your punches.”
“At kung mayroong ibang mga legal na operasyon na gagawin ang DILG, definitely mayroon tayong kasabihan na ‘do not telegraph your punches,’” she added.
